04 / 07
The model

Every exercise exists three times

<stage>/startFailing tests, empty bodies, no hints.
<stage>/guidedSame tests, numbered TODOs. The escape hatch.
<stage>/solutionGreen, with NOTES.md on the trade-offs.

The tests are byte-identical across all three. Only the implementation changes.

PROGRAM · THE REPO
05 / 07
How they stay in sync

Written once, generated, then checked

// in the solution — ordinary comments, no build step
// #hint 1 The timer id lives in the closure.
// #region solution … // #endregion

$ pnpm stage:publish module-3/utils   # → guided, start
$ pnpm stage:verify  module-3/utils
✓ solution  expected pass, got pass
✓ guided / start  expected fail, got fail
✓ test files identical across all three

A starter whose tests accidentally pass is a lesson with nothing to do in it. A machine catches that, not a support message three weeks after launch.

PROGRAM · THE REPO
06 / 07
Day one, module one

The whole workflow is three commands

$ git checkout module-3/utils/start        # red: 47 failing
$ pnpm test:watch                          # work until green
$ git diff module-3/utils/solution -- src/ # compare, don't just check

Taught once in module 1, used for the rest of the program — and it's the git workflow they'll use at work.
